# Open Sesame artwork

`open-sesame-logo.png` is the exact owner-supplied “Open Sesame in Coven Black.png” artwork selected on November 8, 2026, superseding the earlier charcoal tile. Its SHA-256 is `759ea1a3eca47d501407401282a0c751027f089c86bcb142fe7e1bd8f142e837`. The original 1254 × 1254 RGBA PNG and alpha channel are preserved byte-for-byte. The native build derives all standard/Retina icon sizes using the macOS image tools without redrawing or cropping the mark. The application header, web/sign-in branding, favicon, Finder icon and menu-bar icon use this same source.
